summary: One-time collision system startup routine: clears the global mutex handle, clears the initialized flag, marks the lock state as unlocked, then creates an unnamed mutex via the imported CreateMutexA and records its handle. On success the initialized flag is set to 1. Returns the mutex handle.

operations.description: Clear the global mutex handle slot dword_7CD264 to 0.
Clear the initialized flag byte_7CD26C to 0.
Set the lock state dword_7CD268 to -1, marking the mutex as unlocked.
Prepare a SECURITY_ATTRIBUTES structure: nLength = 12, lpSecurityDescriptor = NULL, bInheritHandle = 1 (inheritable).
Call the imported kernel32 CreateMutexA with the prepared attributes, initial ownership 0, and NULL name, producing an unnamed mutex.
Store the returned mutex handle into the global handle slot dword_7CD264.
Guard on the mutex creation result being non-null.
When creation succeeded, set the initialized flag byte_7CD26C to 1.
Return the mutex handle (result of CreateMutexA, NULL on failure).
